paraFuncs.hint: Cambridge 心理学家想比较的是什么？
paraFuncs.why: 首段提出研究问题：只'看'与主动'判美'对认知的影响有何不同。

paraFuncs.hint: 187人如何被分成两组？两组的任务差在哪里？
paraFuncs.why: randomly divided + 两组任务对照，是实验设计的骨架。

paraFuncs.hint: 14% 与 25% 分别说明了什么？
paraFuncs.why: 整体差14%；有艺术爱好者中差25%——主效应+调节效应。

paraFuncs.hint: 审美组'自我超越感'更高但'并不更快乐'——这个对照排除了什么解释？
paraFuncs.why: 排除'单纯积极情绪'的替代解释，锁定'美的投入'本身。

paraFuncs.hint: Schnall 把屏幕思维与走神神游对比，想说明什么？
paraFuncs.why: 借研究者之口把实验结论引申到数字生活方式。

paraSummaries.summary: Cambridge psychologists ran an experiment comparing merely seeing art with actively judging its beauty.
187 visitors were split into a beauty-rating group and a control group, then tested on practical vs abstract thinking.
The beauty group scored 14% higher overall in abstract thinking, and 25% higher among artistic-hobby holders.
Beauty-group visitors reported more self-transcendent feelings but not more happiness, isolating beauty as the cause.
Schnall suggests that admiring beauty may be an ideal way to trigger abstract thinking rarely exercised on screens.

trace.correctText: P2 · 主动评判并给每件作品的美打分
trace.correctQuote: then rate the beauty of each object they viewed
trace.hint: beauty 组比 control 组多做的那件事是什么？
trace.why: rate the beauty＝给美评级（B）；Draw outlines 是 control 组的线条匹配任务的混淆项。

trace.stem: Which participants got the highest score on average in the test?
trace.correctText: P3 · 有艺术爱好的审美组（高出25%）
opts: P3 · 审美组且有艺术爱好
P3 · 审美组无艺术爱好
P3 · 对照组且有艺术爱好
P3 · 对照组无艺术爱好
trace.correctQuote: those with an artistic hobby in the beauty group scored over 25% higher on average for abstract thinking than those with an artistic hobby in the control group.
trace.hint: 25% 这个最大差值出现在哪两组之间？
trace.why: over 25% higher 限定 beauty×artistic-hobby 组最高——A。

trace.stem: Why were the participants' emotional states measured?
trace.correctText: P4 · 排除情绪替代解释，锁定真正因素
opts: P4 · 发现其对艺术的态度
P4 · 判断思维方式类型
P4 · 确定结果背后的因素
trace.correctQuote: rather than any overall positivity from the experience.
trace.hint: 如果审美组只是'更开心'才得分高，实验还成立吗？测量情绪是为了排除什么？
trace.why: 测情绪是为排除'快乐驱使'的替代解释，确定结果背后的真实因素（D）。

trace.stem: What is the major finding of the study regarding the appreciation of art?
trace.correctText: P5 · 审美欣赏激发抽象思维
opts: P5 · 激发抽象认知过程
trace.correctQuote: Admiring the beauty of art may be the ideal way to initiate the abstract cognitive processes.
trace.hint: 结论句里 initiate 的宾语是什么？
trace.why: 核心变量是 abstract thinking（D）；'更快乐'被 P4 明确排除。

inter.hint: 提出研究问题后，接着展示的是实验的什么？
分组设置与随后两组数据的差值是什么关系？

intra.hint: tested on how they process information——被测的是谁的信息处理方式？
intra.why: they 回指 All participants，代词向最近复数先行词取值。

intra.correctText: Importantly, however 双重强调转折
intra.item: Importantly, however, the beauty group did not report feeling any happier
intra.hint: Importantly 与 however 叠用，作者要读者特别注意到哪个反差？
intra.why: '超越感更高但快乐不更高'——转折锁定美的专效性。

intra.correctText: scored / higher / average / abstract thinking 数据链
intra.item: scored almost 14% higher on average than the control group in abstract thinking
intra.hint: scored/higher/average 组成了什么性质的语义场？
intra.why: 数据比较词汇链是研究报告的语篇标识。

argument.hint: 14%、25% 以及 beauty/control 两组的反复对举，用了哪两种方法？
argument.why: 数字与对照是实验说明的双引擎。

sentences.kind: 被动语态 + 过去分词
sentences.sen: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed
sentences.ana: were divided / was asked 双被动交代实验流程；they viewed 过去分词短语修饰 object。

sentences.kind: 比较结构 + 状语密集
sentences.sen: those in the beauty group scored almost 14% higher on average than the control group in abstract thinking
sentences.ana: those in... 泛指替代 + almost 14% higher...than... 比较框架 + in abstract thinking 限定维度——数据句模板。

sentences.kind: 形式主语 + 表语从句
sentences.sen: It's becoming much rarer to zone out and just let the mind wander, but that's when we think in ways that broaden our minds.
sentences.ana: It 形式主语；that's when 引导表语从句；in ways that... 定语从句嵌套——收束句兼有哲思。

rhetoric.sen: the beauty group did not report feeling any happier than the control group
rhetoric.ana: 以'快乐未增'反衬'超越感提升'——用对照锁定因果专属。

rhetoric.sen: “We usually think in very concrete terms when doing something on a screen,” said Simone Schnall, senior author of the study.
rhetoric.ana: 援引第一作者的话引申结论，并自然带出屏幕生活的现实关切。

concepts.def: 抽象思维——超越具体事物的概念化思考
对照组——接受基线任务以供比较的小组
自我超越的——超出个人利害的情绪体验（如感动、顿悟）
